about_the_game:
**In the not-so-distant future, the world has fallen.**

A mysterious, highly contagious virus has swept across the globe, transforming the infected into monstrous, mutated beings known only as **"The Forgotten."**

Cities lie in ruin. Civilization has collapsed. And the few remaining survivors cling to hope in the shadows of a new threat: intelligent machines.

Once built to serve mankind, advanced sci-fi robotics have gone rogue—twisted by corrupted code and emotionless logic. No longer bound by human control, these AI-driven constructs have turned hostile.

The final directive? Deploy a doomsday atomic payload to erase all traces of what’s left—human or otherwise.

But there is one last mission.

**Captain Brad Mercer**—a former elite military officer and one of the rare few immune to the virus—emerges from the ashes. Hardened by war, driven by purpose, and haunted by loss, Brad holds the experience and resilience needed for humanity's final stand.

short_description: Fight to save humanity from a robotic apocalypse and a monstrous threat lurking in the shadows. Uncover the power behind the machines and find the legendary weapon to stop them. Your mission: survive and save the world.
